title: 第672章 传承第671章 帝国周边的就特么没有一个帝国是好东西
slug: 领主神级词条招募原罪堕天使
lines: “他们是他们国内的寡头还是？”苏业有些好奇的问道。
毛子那边最大的五个医药集团，其中四个都是寡头的存在，剩下一个有半个帝国的背景。
实际上和赤色毛熊的时期并没有什么太大的区别。
从根子上他们就是白色人种，赤色毛熊倒下之后，他们也是如此，别说什么大帝清洗了多少寡头。
的确清洗了不少，但是那是国外的寡头，毛子帝国内部的寡头可从来没有少过啊。
对于毛子的态度，苏业算不上好，心里也清楚这这头熊还有用，所以苏业才会这么一问。
到底是帝国，还是帝国内的寡头，这有很大的区别的。
“是他们帝国的人来。”老爷子沉声的说道。
苏业挑了挑眉，看样子毛子的确是扛不住了，否则的话，他们帝国的人也不会来。
要知道毛子那边可是一直都看不起帝国的，这是事实，大部分都是如此。
“啧啧，那老爷子你说我该要价多少?”苏业看向老爷子问道。
“就和白头鹰那边一样吧，多了也不好，现在毛子也穷，处于一个尴尬的位置，低一点也行，最起码毛子没倒下之前，那边的破事不会出现在帝国周边。”老爷子轻声的说说道。
“行吧，那我明白你的意思了。”苏业看向老爷子。
的确白头鹰带来的影响，仅仅是在欧美那边，对于帝国周边的影响还不是很大。
最起码现在不是那么大，不管是岛国，还是棒子国，也没有学习欧美那边，什么亚空间生灵也是生灵之类的批话。
毛子挡着也是一件好事情。
“话说老爷子，毛子那边应该没那么不堪吧？”苏业有些想不明白，现在的毛子这么拉了吗？
“他比想象的要弱，但是也没你想象的那么弱。”老爷子轻声的说道。
苏业一愣，这话说的云里雾里的。
“总之，现在的毛子还有掀桌子的底气，最大的问题就是不知道以后还有没有了。”老爷子幽幽的说道。
苏业表示明白的点了点头。
“你知道帝国和其他国家最大的不同是什么吗？”老爷子看向苏业问了一句。
“传承？”苏业想了想，这大概是帝国和其他国家最大的不同的地方。
那就是传承。
这种传承整个世界只有帝国有。
除了帝国之外其他帝国都没有帝国的传承。
帝国也是最特殊的存在。
“是的，就是传承，这些帝国传承的太少了，弱的可怜那点底蕴。”老爷子摇了摇头。
没有看不起的意思，只是在说一些事实，一些古老的传承一直都在帝国之中。
从未断过，但是国外就不行。
至于说岛国，棒子国，帝国周边的这些小国。
emmm，他们也算是有传承吧，不过都是依附帝国的存在，从古至今皆是如此。
“他们有底蕴，但是放在以往的时代还行，但是这个时代就不行了，看不清未来，注定会湮灭在历史的长河之中，回首往昔追溯岁月史书，帝国的敌人一个有一个，到最后终究还是只剩下了帝国，这就是传承。”老爷子轻声的说道。
“帝国最大的底蕴不是什么气运之兽，而是传承，这个你以后就知道了。”老爷子轻声的说道。
苏业看向老爷子一愣，看样子帝国好像还有很多东西啊。
不过也对，一个从未断过的古老民族，传承到现在，真靠着一尊气运之兽的话也走不到现在。
帝国不会还有其他纪元的老怪物活着吧。
一想到这个可能，好像还真有这个可能，帝国的历史很长，长的普通人一生都看不完。
自己或许该去看看帝国的历史书了，当然不是普通的历史，而是一些被藏起来的东西。
content_en:
"Are they oligarchs in their country?" Su ye asked curiously.
Four of the five largest pharmaceutical groups in Maozi are oligarchs, and the remaining one has a background of half an empire.
In fact, there is not much difference from the period of the red fur bear.
From their roots, they are white people, and they will be the same after the fall of the red fur bear, not to mention how many oligarchs the emperor has purged.
It is true that a lot of them were purged, but those were foreign oligarchs. There have never been fewer oligarchs within Maozi's empire.
Su ye's attitude towards Mao Zi was not good, and he knew in his heart that this bear was still useful, so Su ye asked like this.
There is a big difference between whether it is an empire or an oligarch within an empire.
"It's people from their empire who are here." The old man said in a deep voice.
Su ye raised his eyebrows. It seemed that Mao Zi couldn't bear it anymore. Otherwise, no one from their empire would come.
You must know that Maozi has always looked down on the empire. This is a fact, most of them are like this.
"Tsk, tsk, how much do you think I should charge, old man?" Su ye looked at the old man and asked.
"It's just like the Bald Eagle. Too much is not good. Now Maozi is also poor and in an awkward position. It's okay to be lower. At least before Maozi falls, the bad things over there won't appear around the empire." The old man said softly.
"Okay, then I understand what you mean." Su ye looked at the old man.
It is true that the impact of the Bald Eagle is only in Europe and the United States, and it does not have a great impact on the surrounding areas of the empire.
At least it is not that big now. Whether it is an island country or a stick country, it has not learned from Europe and the United States that all subspace creatures are also creatures.
It's also a good thing that Maozi is blocking it.
"Speaking of which, old man, Mao Zi's side shouldn't be that bad, right?" Su ye was a little confused. Is Mao Zi like this now?
"He is weaker than expected, but not as weak as you think." The old man said softly.
Su ye was stunned for a moment, what he said was confusing.
"In short, Mao Zi still has the confidence to lift the table. The biggest problem is that I don't know if he will do it again in the future." The old man said quietly.
Su ye nodded in understanding.
"Do you know what is the biggest difference between the empire and other countries?" The old man looked at Su ye and asked.
"Inheritance?" Su ye thought for a moment. This is probably the biggest difference between the empire and other countries.
That is inheritance.
Only the empire has this kind of inheritance in the entire world.
Except for the Empire, no other empire has the legacy of the Empire.
The empire is also the most special existence.
"Yes, it is inheritance. These empires have inherited too little, and their little heritage is so weak." The old man shook his head.
I don't mean to look down on it, I'm just stating some facts. Some ancient inheritance has always been in the empire.
It has never been broken, but it does not work abroad.
As for island countries, stick countries, and these small countries around the empire.
Emmm, they can be considered to have inheritance, but they are all dependent on the empire, and this has been the case since ancient times.
"They have a foundation, but it was okay in the past era, but not in this era. They can't see the future clearly, and they are destined to be lost in the long river of history. Looking back on the past and tracing back the history books, there are enemies of the empire one by one. In the end, only the empire is left. This is inheritance." The old man said softly.
"The greatest heritage of the empire is not the beast of luck, but inheritance. You will know this later." The old man said softly.
Su ye looked at the old man and was stunned. It seemed that the empire still had a lot of things.
But that's right, an ancient nation that has never been discontinued, and its inheritance has been passed down to this day, would not be able to reach this point if it really relied on a beast of luck.
There won’t be any old monsters from other eras alive in the empire.
When I think about this possibility, it seems that it is really possible. The history of the empire is very long, and it is too long for ordinary people to see it all in a lifetime.
Maybe you should read the history books of the empire. Of course, it's not ordinary history, but some hidden things.
